Subject: HelixAI recommit plan — term changes, capacity uplift, and QBR slots

Hi Alyssa / Jordan —

Thanks again for the sync last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kickoff a short renewal / expansion plan so we have clear milestones for the contract amendment (term + throughput bump) and an operational QBR to align execs and SREs. High-level asks and timeline below.

What I need from you this week:
- Confirm primary commercial contact (for PO/SOW) and procurement timeline.
- Pick one of the two QBR windows below or propose an alternate.
- Share any updated capacity projections (tokens/day) — a single row in the attached spreadsheet is fine.

Proposed near-term timeline (target dates):
- 04/08: Kickoff + playbook share (this email + attachments)
- 04/12: Procurement/Legal target for draft amendment or redline
- 04/19: Technical QBR with SREs + perf readout (30–60m)
- 05/01: Contract signature / capacity provisioning kickoff

QBR slot options (pick one):
- Option A: Tue 04/16 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred for our SREs)
- Option B: Thu 04/18 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments: Helix_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (summary of change requests & mutual action items) and Helix_Capacity_Reqs.xlsx (please update tokens/day row).

A few quick notes: if Helix wants a stepped staircase over a 6–12 month window instead of an immediate uplift we can draft a commit schedule and reserve burst capacity for anticipated peaks. Marissa will own onboarding ops and Soojin will lead technical validation. Karthik will hold pricing for the uplift and coordinate the amendment.

Next steps: Alyssa, can you confirm who from procurement to include and which QBR slot works? I’ll follow up with a calendar poll once I have your pick.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Senior ARR Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194
